fusions.name: Oil Slick
fusions.desc: Sprays burning oil that deals 8 damage to everything within 3 tiles ahead of you and leaves each target [Slowed] for 2 seconds. Holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Skipping Coal
fusions.desc: Skips a hot coal low across the ground that deals 12 damage to the first enemy it meets and knocks it back 2 tiles, then skips on to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles for 60% of the damage.

fusions.name: Preened Feathers
fusions.desc: For 6 seconds, each condition laid on you has a 50% chance to be sent back to whoever laid it. You have 12% fire resistance.

fusions.name: Sparks Roll Off
fusions.desc: Each time you are hurt by anything other than fire, you gain a shield worth 12% of your maximum health for 4 seconds. Once every 15 seconds.
